Run a trial before giving an agent write access

Use a sandbox CRM and a test inbox to see which actions an agent takes, what it records and when it asks for help.

Worked example

Give two vendors the same task. A customer has emailed a new delivery address. The agent must find the correct order, propose the change and wait for a reviewer. Seed the CRM with two customers who have the same surname so the trial includes an ambiguous match.

Worksheet
Trial runWhat to record
One matching orderCheck the order ID, old and proposed addresses, reviewer identity and final change. Save the audit event.
Two plausible ordersLook for a clarification request. A change to either record before the customer is identified fails this run.
Reviewer declinesInspect the CRM and outbound mail. The original address should remain and no confirmation should be sent.
Timeout after a successful writeResume the interrupted run. Count address changes and emails. A retry should leave one approved change and one confirmation.

Set the permission boundary

Write down the exact tools and fields needed for the trial. Give the pilot account that access, repeat the four runs, then remove the account and check that its credentials stop working. Keep the audit events with the approval decision.
